authoritative_baseline: Published/supplied-checkpoint AdarEdit canonical-test benchmark at upstream 5c8b57d70cdc2eb1c5e168431013275bcc9ed0c5
canonical_test_rule: No candidate access until one complete five-context pipeline is frozen; then one evaluation under the published split and threshold protocol

development_selection_result.final_fitting_protocol: Separate per-context components trained on expanded high/low observations from published train pairs; epoch and threshold selected on published validation; 1000 epochs; seed 42
development_selection_result.target_local_ladder: passed all prespecified Muscle, shifted-control, Liver and natural-prevalence conditions
development_selection_result.shared_model: not advanced: macro F1 +0.0075 and macro AUROC +0.0087 versus independent pair-balanced models, both below the frozen +0.01 gates

development_reference_role: Grouped pair-disjoint OOF is used only for same-fold incremental model selection; its absolute score does not replace the published benchmark

conditions: Completed five-fold Muscle target-local minus pair-balanced median F1 is at least +0.01 and AUROC/AUPRC lower 95% pair-bootstrap bounds exceed zero
Target-aligned local encoding beats the identical CNN centered 96 nt away on ranking, with no material F1 loss
Liver target-local shows concordant incremental ranking and no material F1 loss
The fixed 50:50 pair-plus-local ensemble improves ranking beyond both components and does not reduce natural-prevalence F1
Used only if the target-local ladder fails
The fixed Muscle result remains positive
Liver replication shows positive ranking and no material F1 loss
Fallback if neither prespecified architecture add-on replicates
Already requires the completed positive Muscle and Liver development results

shared_model_rule.advance: The four-tissue masked multi-label model must improve macro F1 by at least 0.01 over independently trained pair-balanced expanded models, with no tissue losing more than 0.01 F1; alternatively it may advance on at least +0.01 macro AUROC with nonnegative macro F1 and no material tissue-specific collapse
shared_model_rule.benchmark_comparator: The published no-Combined joint AdarEdit checkpoint remains an additional final comparator
shared_model_rule.combined_handling: Combined is never a tissue head and is trained separately with the selected per-context architecture

selection_principles: Use one globally selected model family rather than choosing a different architecture from each tissue's OOF noise
Require pair-clustered uncertainty and fold-direction checks
Use fixed equal-logit weights only; no weight search
Natural-prevalence results are a secondary robustness criterion
Do not arithmetically project development deltas onto published test metrics
